title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Judges 19: the Levite and his concubine, the long stay in Bethlehem, and the night in Gibeah.

questions.text: From where did the Levite take his concubine?
questions.explanation: The Levite, living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim, took a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah.

questions.text: How long was the concubine at her father's house before her husband came after her?
questions.explanation: She went away to her father's house in Bethlehem Judah and was there for four months.

questions.text: How long did the Levite first stay with his father-in-law?
questions.explanation: His father-in-law kept him there, and he stayed with him three days, eating and drinking.

questions.text: By what other name is Jebus called in this chapter?
questions.explanation: The man went near Jebus, which the text says is also called Jerusalem.

questions.text: Why did the Levite refuse to stay in Jebus?
questions.explanation: He said they would not enter the city of a foreigner that was not of the children of Israel, but would pass over to Gibeah.

answers.text: Its gates were already shut for the night
His servant had fallen ill there
It was too far from the road
It was a city of foreigners, not of Israel

questions.text: To which tribe did Gibeah belong?
questions.explanation: The sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.

questions.text: Where was the old man coming from when he saw the travelers in the street?
questions.explanation: An old man came from his work out of the field at evening; he was from the hill country of Ephraim and lived in Gibeah.

answers.text: From his work in the field

questions.text: Besides heading home, where did the Levite tell the old man he was going?
questions.explanation: The Levite said, "I am going to Yahweh's house; and there is no one who has taken me into his house."

questions.text: Who surrounded the old man's house and beat at the door?
questions.explanation: The men of the city, certain wicked fellows, surrounded the house and beat at the door.

questions.text: Into how many pieces did the Levite divide his concubine before sending her throughout Israel?
questions.explanation: He took a knife and divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel.
